summary.one_liner: A curated list of resources for product and program managers, covering tools, articles, books, podcasts, communities, and conferences.
summary.what_it_does: This is an awesome-style link list rather than software. It is organized into sections: Tools (note-taking, task and project management, design and prototyping, roadmapping and feedback, OKR tracking), Articles (grouped by product fundamentals, development process, strategy, customer research, team leadership, metrics, career, and growth), and Books (grouped by fundamentals, strategy, research and UX, development process, leadership, psychology, and engineering). It also lists podcasts with hosts and descriptions, communities, conferences, and a few additional resources. Tool entries include a table with developer, cost, and platform, but the URL fields are blank in the README. The list states that it is a set of pointers, not a definitive guide to what PMs must do.
use_cases: Finding reading material on product management
Choosing note-taking or documentation tools for PM work
Comparing roadmapping and user feedback tools
Picking product management books for self-study
Looking up PM conferences to attend
notable: Covers tools, articles, books, podcasts, communities, and conferences in one list
Tool entries include developer, cost, and platform tables
Articles and books are grouped by topic such as strategy, research, and leadership
Includes a range of older classic essays and newer posts
caveats: Tool URL fields are empty in the README, so links to products must be found elsewhere
Pricing and platform details may be out of date
Entries are pointers and opinions, not endorsements of a single best tool
